title: Innovations in Proteomic Technologies and Artificial Neural Networks: Unlocking Milk Origin Identification.
summary: FNN trained on MALDI-TOF milk spectra; Methods describes train/validation/test split. Results reports species classification on held-out spectra; datasets comprise 648 bovine, 1,554 caprine and 2,392 ovine spectra. The bibliographic records retrieved do not state an author affiliation.
